# Fotografo Santo Domingo | Babula Shots

> Babula Shots is a professional photography studio based in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, offering wedding, portrait, event, family, commercial, and drone photography. Content and booking are fully bilingual (Spanish and English).

Last updated: 2026-08-27

## Primary pages

- [Spanish homepage](https://www.fotografosantodomingo.com/es): Core service overview and booking CTAs.
- [English homepage](https://www.fotografosantodomingo.com/en): English-language homepage for international visitors.

- [About the photographer (EN)](https://www.fotografosantodomingo.com/en/about): Photographer profile and background in English.

## Proposal & wedding photography

- [Proposal photography hub (EN)](https://www.fotografosantodomingo.com/en/proposal): Proposal photography covering all of the Dominican Republic, with package comparison.
- [Hidden/telephoto proposal photography (ES)](https://www.fotografosantodomingo.com/es/propuesta/fotografo-propuesta-oculta-modo-ninja): Discreet, hidden-mode proposal photography, island-wide.
- [Zona Colonial proposal photography (ES)](https://www.fotografosantodomingo.com/es/bodas/fotografo-propuesta-matrimonio-zona-colonial-santo-domingo): Surprise proposal planning and photography in the Colonial Zone, Santo Domingo.
- [Punta Cana proposal photographer (EN)](https://www.fotografosantodomingo.com/en/punta-cana-proposal-photographer): Dedicated Punta Cana proposal photography landing page.
- [Proposal photography service page (ES)](https://www.fotografosantodomingo.com/es/services/proposal-photography): Full proposal photography service page with per-city coverage (Santo Domingo, Punta Cana).
- [Zona Colonial wedding photography (ES)](https://www.fotografosantodomingo.com/es/bodas/zona-colonial-santo-domingo): Wedding photography in Santo Domingo's UNESCO-listed Zona Colonial.
- [Baptism photography, Santo Domingo (ES)](https://www.fotografosantodomingo.com/es/eventos/fotografo-bautizo-santo-domingo): Baptism photography in Santo Domingo's Zona Colonial churches, with coverage across the Dominican Republic.
